The Atlantic Lottery Mobile App allows you to enjoy all of the benefits of having an alc.ca account from your mobile device. It's available on tablet and smartphone, for iOS in the App Store and for Android in the Google Play Store.
Play your favourite LOTTO, Casino*, Instant Wins and iBingo games, make your PRO•LINE picks, and scan tickets to see if you've won!
Download for iOS Download for Android
Exciting and fun Instant Wins and Casino* games from your device anywhere, anytime. Convenience in the palm of your hand.
*Casino games available in NB, NS, & NL only.
Your LOTTO tickets in fewer steps! Now with easy access to manage your LOTTO tickets in My ALC. Enhanced experience for checking Winning numbers, Jackpots and prize payouts.
Scan your tickets to see if you won and deposit winnings up to $999.99* right into your Atlantic Lottery account.
Choose one of our many safe and secure payment methods to fund your account.
Take a break from the action and set limits specific to you with our online PlayWise tools.
100% of Atlantic Lottery profit helps fund things like healthcare and education in our communities.
